semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides integrated technology services specifically for the semiconductor manufacturing industry.
summary: Suzhou Xwesun Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the repair and refurbishment of semiconductor integrated circuit equipment, including critical components such as base heaters and vacuum pumps. The company also focuses on R&D and manufacturing of core components, enhancing production efficiency and reducing costs for its customers.
capabilities: Repair of semiconductor integrated circuit equipment
Localization of R&D and manufacturing of electrical controls

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Suzhou Industrial Park and actively collaborates with local universities for R&D.
